title: The New Life in Christ Fellowship Agusan Pequeño - The GLORIOUS CHURCH has been very good to me not only spiritually but also physically.... last year i can barely walk 20 meters only... but now because not only through prayers i have been active also through evangelism in our community... i'm amazed i can now walk more than 2 kilometers without dropping a sweat... i lost more than a hundred kilos in less than a year.... Thank you GOD for restoring my HEALTH and most especially my relationship with my family. I am very much happy with the transformation of my life.
paragraphs: The New Life in Christ Fellowship Agusan Pequeño - The GLORIOUS CHURCH has been very good to me not only spiritually but also physically....  last year i can barely walk 20 meters only... but now because not only through prayers i have been active also through evangelism in our community...  i'm amazed i can now walk more than 2 kilometers without dropping a sweat... i lost more than a hundred kilos in less than a year.... Thank you GOD for restoring my HEALTH and most especially my relationship with my family.  I am very much happy with the transformation of my life.
i do specially thank Pastor Rey Sanico and Pastora Cecile Sanico for the support and advice they gave along the way of my journey towards a better me in my life with Christ Jesus.
And to Pastor Ian Calo for taking me as a partner for the ministries. :)
it's TRUE.. Faith can move Mountains... in my case.. it removes MOUNTAINS of FAT from me. ;)
